data.title: SOBR Safe Transitions From Nasdaq Listing To OTC Markets
data.description:
SOBR Safe ( (SOBR) ) has issued an update.

On September 14, 2026, SOBR Safe, Inc. was notified by Nasdaq that its common stock would be delisted from the Nasdaq Capital Market at the open of trading on September 16, 2026, following a prolonged failure to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement and prior substantial reverse stock splits that rendered the company ineligible for a standard compliance period. Despite a temporary stay and a plan to regain compliance, including a proposed merger with Clean World Ventures, Nasdaq staff also determined in August 2026 that SOBR Safe no longer met the minimum stockholders’ equity requirements, and the board, doubting the merger could close by its October 15, 2026 deadline, opted not to pursue further appeals.

As a result, SOBR Safe’s shares ceased trading on Nasdaq on September 16, 2026 and transitioned to quotation on the OTC Markets under the same ticker, with the company seeking listing on the OTCQB tier, a move that shifts its stock to a less regulated, less visible venue that may affect liquidity and investor access while potentially reducing listing-related costs. The likely termination of the merger agreement with Clean World Ventures underscores the company’s continued listing and capital structure challenges, leaving stakeholders to adjust to trading in the over-the-counter environment and to reassess SOBR Safe’s prospects without the support of a major exchange listing.

data.title: Paytm Sees Revenue Upside as NPCI Introduces MDR on High-Value UPI Merchant Payments
data.description:
One 97 Communications Ltd. ( (IN:PAYTM) ) has provided an announcement.

India’s National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has introduced a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of up to 0.4% on UPI Person-to-Merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000, effective October 15, 2026. The MDR will apply to merchants accepting larger-ticket UPI payments, while customers will continue to pay no fees for using UPI.

One 97 Communications Limited, the operator of Paytm, expects this change to generate additional revenue from its merchant business, particularly on transactions that were previously free. The company has indicated it will assess the financial and operational impact of the NPCI circular once implemented and provide further disclosures as required under SEBI listing regulations.
